notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: A few designs, but most are flat with no depth and have an off-centre reflector.

notes.subject: guardrail
notes.text: Uses B-profile guardrails exclusively; its southern neighbour does not.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Chevrons are a black arrow on white, also seen in Slovenia, Montenegro and North Macedonia.

notes.subject: plate
notes.text: White plates with a blue strip on the left; tractors and farm vehicles have green plates. Croatian and Macedonian plates often lack the strip.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: Slavic language written in both Cyrillic and Latin. Ђ and Ћ are unique to it; Љ Њ Џ are shared only with Macedonian.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: In Latin script it uses Č, Ć, Đ, Š and Ž, shared with Croatian and Montenegrin.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Most Generation 3 coverage has no antenna; elsewhere in central and eastern Europe an antenna is the norm, except North Macedonia.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Four different truck colours were used in different areas.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Generation 4 is smallcam, mounted low with a big round blur and a small protrusion; a short antenna or black blur shows at the rear.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A white car with a short antenna appears around the north, the capital and Niš, and the E75 linking them, though not always visible.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Extremely flat farmland with no hills at all from the Hungarian border to the capital.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: A slight ridge in the otherwise flat plain marks the national park southwest of Novi Sad.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Mountains jutting from a flat plain near the Romanian border, with vineyards to the south and a castle on top.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: Bilingual signs with Hungarian appear in northern Vojvodina, where Hungarians are the majority.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Slightly rolling hills in the central north; the southern river basin is similar but with larger hills and mountains.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Lush green mountains in the south and southeast along the Bulgarian and Kosovo borders; the highest ranges are in the southwest and southeast.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Two-digit area codes: 2x in the north, 1x in the centre and east, 3x in the southwest.
